result:
I fixed both #897 defects in two commits, both pushed fast-forward to `develop`: step 1 is `68f83b0a` and step 2 is `f76c4d86` (`Fixes: #897`). Each new test failed on the unfixed compiler and passes now. The gate is green, clippy is clean and `pre-push-check` passed.

- **Step 1, text `+` of a field (`emit_core_leaves.nika`):** a side of a text `+` that is a field, at any depth, is now lent as `&str`, the same way an indexed side already was. I lend every field side, not only those reached through a lent parameter, because the emitter has no easy way to tell an owned local from a borrowed one. That is always correct; for a field of an owned local it costs at most the reuse of one buffer. The test `a_text_plus_of_a_lent_field` covers the brief's probe as an argument, a `let`, a `return` and a nested field.
- **Step 2, owned local in an arm (`check_arm_leaves.nika`, `lent_arms_view_and_new`):** a named arm that is neither a view nor a lent name is treated as an owned local and lent, not moved, so it stays usable after the call.
  - Beside a value made in the other arm, it becomes `Arm::View(&t)`, or `either(&s)` for text.
  - When no arm makes a value, the arms are lent as they are: `&if c { &t } else { &u }`.
  - Text with no made arm still goes through `EitherText`, because `&String` and `&str` are two different types in the arms.
  - The test `an_owned_local_lent_through_arms` covers `if` and `match`, a struct and `String`, and arms that are both owned locals.
- **Tests run:** `nikaia test --both-settings --project tests/compiler` (188 ok), and `it` filtered on `handed_over`, `text_tiers` and `typecheck` together with the guard set (214 ok). I did not run the `nikaia-std` unit tests: no Rust source changed, only the generated `lowered/` files.
- **Not checked:** a `mut` parameter named in such an arm. `&` of a `&mut P` may not fit `Arm::View`, and no test covers it.
- **Changelog** (step 2's entry; step 1's is in its own report):
  - Step 1: "A text `+` of a field read through a lent parameter lends the field instead of moving it out of the reference."
  - Step 2: "An owned local named in an arm of an argument to a lent parameter is lent through the call and stays usable after it."
- **Disk:** the test cache `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 2.5G and 18G is free on `/`. No new cache entry is over 100 MB, and nothing was freed (no clone was made).
- **Other agents:** I found no errors in their files and did not stage `crates/rs2nika/convert/**`.
